title: Vector Vine Copula Models for Multivariate Longitudinal Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.19547v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multivariate longitudinal data may exhibit non-Gaussian margins, nonlinear dynamics, and response vectors with composition that varies across waves. To account for these features, we introduce a vector drawable vine (VD-vine) copula that extends conventional drawable vine copulas from scalar to vector-valued nodes. Here, the response vector at each wave forms a multivariate marginal, and serial dependence is captured through a sequence of linking vector copulas. We establish that the VD-vine is itself a vector copula and reduces to a conventional drawable vine for scalar nodes. Recursive forward and backward conditional transports are derived that enable efficient likelihood evaluation and predictive simulation, with parsimonious reductions under finite-order Markov and stationary restrictions. translated_title: 面向多元纵向数据的向量藤Copula模型
translated_abstract: 多元纵向数据可能表现出非高斯边际、非线性动态，以及组成随观测波次变化的响应向量。为了刻画这些特征，我们引入了向量可绘制藤（VD-vine）Copula，它将传统的可绘制藤Copula从标量节点扩展到向量值节点。在该模型中，每一波次的响应向量构成一个多元边际，而序列相关性通过一系列连接向量Copula来捕捉。我们证明了VD-vine本身是一个向量Copula，并且在标量节点情形下退化为传统的可绘制藤。我们推导了递归的前向和后向条件传输方法，以实现高效的似然评估与预测模拟，并在有限阶马尔可夫和平稳性约束下给出简洁的简化形式。此外，模型还提供了高斯与FGM连接向量Copula的无约束参数化、灵活的多元边际以及贝叶斯变分推断。
tldr: 本文提出向量可绘制藤Copula模型（VD-vine），将传统藤Copula从标量节点扩展至向量值节点，以刻画多元纵向数据的非高斯边际、非线性动态及随时间变化的响应组成，并通过递归条件传输实现高效的似然评估与预测模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the vector drawable vine (VD-vine) copula, which extends conventional vine copulas from scalar to vector-valued nodes to capture non-Gaussian margins, nonlinear dynamics, and time-varying response compositions in multivariate longitudinal data, enabling efficient likelihood evaluation and predictive simulation through recursive conditional transports.
